articles.title: Where to go after you log in
articles.summary: Dashboard for progress, AI Practice for cases.
articles.body_md:
Pick one of these to begin.

- **Dashboard** if you want to see how you are doing
- **AI Practice** if you want to run a case

Most people start with **AI Practice**. When you are ready to set up a mock, follow the guide on creating a practice session.

articles.title: Using the left sidebar
articles.summary: The main menu for every page in the app.
articles.body_md:
The left sidebar is how you move around.

Common items:

- **Dashboard** — progress and charts
- **AI Practice** — create and run sessions
- **Contact Us** — message the team
- **Community** — posts from other learners
- **Settings** — profile and payments
- **Achievements** — milestones and badges

You may also see extra links such as **Marketplace** or **A to Z**. Tap them the same way as everything else.

articles.title: Create a practice session
articles.summary: Name it, pick stations, tap Create Session.
articles.body_md:
This is how you start a new mock.

1. Open **AI Practice** in the left sidebar
2. Stay on the **Setup** tab
3. Enter a session name and choose how many stations (up to 12)
4. Tap **Create Session**
5. Open the session from **View All Sessions** and start a station

### Good to know

- Stations are assigned for you. You cannot pick one specialty up front
- To reuse cases you already did, use **Combine Stations** or open them from **View All Sessions**

### Free trial

After you sign up, create a session the same way. If the app asks you to upgrade or you cannot see stations, follow the prompt or open **Contact Us**.

articles.title: Find, retry, or review a session
articles.summary: Open View All Sessions to continue or review.
articles.body_md:
Open your past mocks from Setup.

1. Go to **AI Practice** → **Setup**
2. Tap **View All Sessions**
3. Open the session you want

On a station you can:

- **Start New Attempt** for another go
- **Review Last Attempt** for feedback and the transcript

### Attempts

- **Three attempts max** on each station
- **After three,** Start New Attempt is blocked
- **You cannot reset** attempts yourself

### If something goes wrong

- **Glitch used an attempt.** Message **Contact Us** with the session and station names
- **Delete a session.** Use the trash control on View All Sessions

articles.title: Combine stations and flagged cases
articles.summary: Rebuild a mock from past attempts, or reopen flagged cases.
articles.body_md:
### Build a session from past stations

1. Open **AI Practice** → **Combine Stations**
2. Enter a name for the new session
3. Select stations you have already attempted
4. Tap **Create Session**

### Flag a case for later

1. During a mock, tap the **flag** icon near the station indicator
2. Later, open **AI Practice** → **Flagged Stations**
3. Tap **View Details** on the case you want

Flags stay until you remove them.

articles.title: Why a session looks locked
articles.summary: Older sessions can lock when a past plan ends.
articles.body_md:
A session often locks when it belongs to an older plan that has ended.

### What to do

1. Create a **new** session from **AI Practice** → **Setup** under your current access
2. Or open **Settings** → **Payments** if you need to upgrade

### After you resubscribe

1. On **Setup**, turn on **Include previously attempted stations** if you want older cases back
2. Or rebuild from **Combine Stations** using stations you already attempted

articles.title: Run a consultation
articles.summary: Open Simulation, then Start Consultation.
articles.body_md:
Speak with the AI patient like a real consultation.

1. Open the station
2. Go to the **Simulation** tab
3. Tap **Start Consultation**
4. Speak normally. The patient answers by voice

### Tips

- **Best browser.** Prefer Chrome or Edge on a laptop
- **Mic access.** Allow the microphone before you start

### If something goes wrong

- **No reply.** Check the mic, refresh, and try again
- **Timer running, patient silent.** Stop and refresh instead of burning the attempt
- **Still stuck.** Leave the station and use **Contact Us** with the session and station names

articles.title: Feedback, transcript, and scores
articles.summary: Open Review Last Attempt for scores, chat, and plans.
articles.body_md:
Review what happened after a station.

1. Open **View All Sessions**
2. Open your session
3. Tap **Review Last Attempt**

Then use the tabs:

- **Feedback** for Athena scores and comments
- **Simulation** for the transcript
- **Management** for the management plan

### About Red, Amber, and Green

- **Green and Amber** both count as doing well enough
- **Red** marks something to practise next (common early on)

### If something goes wrong

- **Still generating.** Wait a few minutes, then refresh
- **Review missing.** Use **Contact Us** after a finished consultation

articles.title: Debrief with Athena
articles.summary: Talk through your attempt from the Feedback tab.
articles.body_md:
Use Athena to talk through how you did.

1. Open **Review Last Attempt**
2. Go to the **Feedback** tab
3. Tap **Start Debrief**
4. Choose **Debrief Session** to talk through your performance

### Practice as Patient

If you also see **Practice as Patient**, Athena acts as the doctor while you experience the consultation as the patient.

### If something goes wrong

- Stuck on connecting? Refresh, allow the microphone, and try again on a laptop
- Still stuck? Contact Us with the session name

articles.title: Dashboard and progress
articles.summary: Charts, trends, and ideas for what to practise next.
articles.body_md:
Open **Dashboard** in the left sidebar.

You can use it to:

- See charts and trends over time
- Spot sections like Important Observations or skill recommendations, when they appear
- Decide what to practise next in **AI Practice**

For milestones and badges, open **Achievements** in the sidebar.

articles.title: Practice with a colleague
articles.summary: Instant Live Practice, or book a slot in Marketplace.
articles.body_md:
Practise with another person, not only the AI.

1. From your dashboard, tap **Practice with colleague**
2. Choose one option:
   - **Live Practice** for an instant queue match
   - **Schedule Practice** to open **Marketplace** and post or book a slot

### Tips

- Use a laptop. Phone video is not supported for full colleague practice
- Doctor and patient roles are assigned when you join, so you get both sides over time

### Join a booked session

1. Open **Marketplace** → **Upcoming Sessions**
2. Join from 10 minutes before the start until one hour after

### If something goes wrong

- Says too early at the right time? Refresh and check your device clock
- Still wrong? Contact Us with the session time

articles.title: Community
articles.summary: Read posts and ask other learners questions.
articles.body_md:
Open **Community** in the left sidebar to:

- Read posts from other learners
- Ask questions and share tips

Be respectful. Offensive content may be removed.

articles.title: Subscribe or upgrade
articles.summary: Choose a plan under Settings → Payments.
articles.body_md:
Pay for access from Settings.

1. Open **Settings** → **Payments**
2. Choose a plan
3. Finish checkout
4. Refresh, or log out and back in
5. Open **AI Practice** to create a session

You may also see an upgrade prompt when you try to create a session. Follow that prompt if it appears.

### Plans

- Typical lengths are 1, 3, or 6 months
- Station counts depend on your exam and plan
- Check the pricing page on the website for current details

articles.title: I paid but still cannot practise
articles.summary: Log out, check Payments, then try Create Session.
articles.body_md:
Try these steps in order.

1. **Log out** and log back in
2. **Check Payments.** Open **Settings** → **Payments** and confirm the plan looks active
3. **Create a session.** Open **AI Practice** → **Setup** → **Create Session**

Access is usually instant. If nothing changes after a few minutes, refresh and try again.

### Other cases

- **Wrong email.** Contact Us from the account you should have used, and include both addresses
- **Need a receipt.** Open **Settings → Payments** and use **Download receipt** (also emailed at purchase). For older purchases without a download, contact **hello@osceguide.com**

articles.title: Refunds, cancel, and promo codes
articles.summary: No refund after you access a station. Codes are paused.
articles.body_md:
### Cancel

You cannot cancel mid-plan after payment. Access runs until the end of the period you bought.

### Refunds

There is a strict **no refund** policy after you access any station. Read the refund policy before you buy.

For questions before purchase, email hello at osceguide dot com.

### Promo codes

- **Paused for now.** Referral and discount codes are not available
- **We will announce** when codes return
- **Do not pay twice** hoping a code will apply

articles.title: Fix microphone and audio
articles.summary: Allow the mic, use Chrome or Edge on a laptop.
articles.body_md:
Work through this checklist.

1. **Allow the microphone** in the browser
2. **Use Chrome or Edge** on a laptop when you can
3. **Check volume** and the selected mic
4. **Unplug Bluetooth headsets** that fight for the mic

### More tips

- **Phones and tablets.** Avoid in-app browsers
- **Best setup.** Laptop audio is more reliable for AI practice and Live Practice

### If the page is blank

1. Hard refresh
2. Try another browser
3. Turn off aggressive ad blockers for this site

articles.title: Profile, password, and logout
articles.summary: Update Profile in Settings. Log out from the sidebar.
articles.body_md:
### Change your profile

1. Open **Settings** → **Profile**
2. Update your username or change your password
3. Save

Email is read-only in the app. To change email, use **Contact Us**.

### Log out

Tap **Logout** at the bottom of the left sidebar.

articles.title: Upload your CV
articles.summary: Add a PDF from Settings → Profile.
articles.body_md:
1. Open **Settings** → **Profile**
2. Tap **Upload CV**
3. Choose a PDF

If you see an onboarding checklist when you first open the app, you can upload there too.

articles.title: Talk to Athena for help
articles.summary: Start a voice chat from this help panel.
articles.body_md:
Use Athena when you want spoken help with the app.

1. Tap **Start conversation** in this panel
2. Ask how to use a feature
3. Follow highlights on screen when guidance is on

### What Athena is for here

- Help with the product and navigation

If you also see **Ask our knowledge base**, use that for clinical questions about conditions and management.

articles.title: Contact Us
articles.summary: Message the team when these guides are not enough.
articles.body_md:
Open **Contact Us** in the left sidebar and send a message.

### What to include

- Practice problems: session and station names
- Billing: the payment email

### What to ask the team (not Athena)

- Reset account or exam data
- Fix attempts lost to technical issues
- Feature requests such as adding your own cases
